**Approach:** Single self-contained HTML file using the Tailwind CDN + a config block seeded entirely from real measured values — colors and fonts pulled straight from the live theme's CSS custom properties (`--color-text-dark:#656565`, `--color-announcement-bg:#efe9db`, `---font-stack-body: Poppins`, `---font-stack-heading: "Alegreya Sans"`, `---font-stack-accent: Questrial`), not guessed. **Componentized:** the 8-item product grid (image/title/price, identical markup repeated), the 5-tile "Shop Today" collection grid, and the brand logo bar — all confirmed as genuinely-repeated, same-purpose fragments before treating them as one component.

**Special handling:**
- The hero carousel's two real slides only differ by one having a CTA button — I built a tiny vanilla-JS fade carousel (no jQuery/slick needed for just 2 slides) using the exact same source images, which turned out to have "SUMMER VIBES LOADING" and "Life is Good exclusive Martin LX1 guitar…" baked into the image pixels themselves (verified by fetching and viewing the actual PNGs, not guessed).

- **Flagged as out of scope / unrecreatable:** a newsletter popup and its iframe (`#widget2`) are injected client-side by a third-party marketing app with no equivalent in the raw HTML — I did not fabricate it, since it isn't real page content.

**Fidelity check:** ran 8 rounds of crow-nester screenshot → odiff. ## Summary

**Approach:** Single self-contained HTML file using the Tailwind CDN + a config block seeded entirely from real measured values — colors and fonts pulled straight from the live theme's CSS custom properties (`--color-text-dark:#656565`, `--color-announcement-bg:#efe9db`, `---font-stack-body: Poppins`, `---font-stack-heading: "Alegreya Sans"`, `---font-stack-accent: Questrial`), not guessed. All images/fonts are hotlinked to the live Shopify CDN per scope.

**Componentized:** the 8-item product grid (image/title/price, identical markup repeated), the 5-tile "Shop Today" collection grid, and the brand logo bar — all confirmed as genuinely-repeated, same-purpose fragments before treating them as one component.

**Special handling:**
- The hero carousel's two real slides only differ by one having a CTA button — I built a tiny vanilla-JS fade carousel (no jQuery/slick needed for just 2 slides) using the exact same source images, which turned out to have "SUMMER VIBES LOADING" and "Life is Good exclusive Martin LX1 guitar…" baked into the image pixels themselves (verified by fetching and viewing the actual PNGs, not guessed).
- The video section's YouTube background/play-button modal was rebuilt as a real `youtube.com/embed` iframe behind a play button, since a live YouTube video has no static markup to hotlink.
- **Flagged as out of scope / unrecreatable:** a newsletter popup and its iframe (`#widget2`) are injected client-side by a third-party marketing app with no equivalent in the raw HTML — I did not fabricate it, since it isn't real page content.

**Fidelity check:** ran 8 rounds of crow-nester screenshot → odiff. Along the way I hit and diagnosed two genuine tool artifacts in crow-nester's full-page capture (not bugs in the clone, confirmed via a direct large-viewport Chrome screenshot): a sticky-header paint glitch and a stitching-seam glitch near the 900px mark. After fixing real issues (header/announcement bar height precisely matched to the live theme's 130px/30px, and pinning every section's height to the exact pixel values measured from the live page's own layout, plus a hero slide-sizing bug), the whole-page diff stabilized at **27.68%**, with the remaining gap concentrated in the excluded popup overlay (a large fixed chunk of "acceptable" diff) and minor residual photo-crop/offset differences in a couple of lower sections — not in the three priority sections, which now land within pixel-accurate section boundaries.
